notes.title: Build 1970
notes.content:
Hi-Scores:
 - Show current user on leader board even if not in the top 10
 - Added rank column to leader board
 - Default local hi-score table now initialized with values that are same as 1up hi-score tier

Firewall Boss tuning:
 - less trigger bots
 - trigger bots don't loop
 - more health (longer battle)
 - added idle timer to maker firewall more active when player doesn't engage

Game play:
 - Added crush charge sound to player
 - Crush animations now runs a little bit slower

Misc:
 - Mission Accomplished and Training Complete achievements added
 - New training complete outro sequence

GFX:
 - Tiling of penultimate level

Improved gamepad configuration screen:
 - Fix: Typo when showing 'select' button text
 - Fix: Read input from 2nd gamepad on the gamepad settings screen.
 - Fix: Show message if chosen button is already assigned on the gamepad setting screen. (Still need to fix message shown)

Worldmap:
- Revised look of final island

notes.title: Build 1960
notes.content:
This is a big update.  Hopefully this gets the game closer to being officially released!!

New Features:

New reworked HUD
New level complete screen
Reworked intro story
Control hint improvements:
	- GFX improved
	- Control tips added to unlock award screens
Award an extra continue each time a score tier is beat in Arcade mode
Boss enemies award points when damaged
New lighting effect on level map
Smoother check point transitions
New Gamepad configuration screen
New Achievements:
	- Kill 100 spike balls
	- Achievement for each boss kill
	- Mmmmonster kill
	
Fixes and Tweaks

Many music track mixes revised / remastered
Balanced some SFX

Improved visibility by differentiating foregrounds and backgrounds on many levels
Adjustments to Krysallix and Sinoid boss battles (graphics, behaviour)

Fix: Dragon mask targeting
Fix: Enemies sometimes go through movers
Fix: In game tips and pause now capture the correct surface from surface renderer
Fix: Light overlay effects on Krysallix level
Fix: Level name shifted down so that HUD is not occluded
Fix: Executor firing explosion effect
Fix; Moving blast blocks killing player
Fix: prevent world map player being drawn before initialized
Fix: Vornoii backgrounds on sine world levels
Fix: Wording regarding controls on a number of in game tips
Fix: Detect resize and adjust final shader resolution in response
Fix: Adjust position of world map intro tip
Fix: HUD shifted to avoid black bars

Firewall Boss: 
	Updated laser charging effect (GFX)
	Firewall lighting tuning
	Death sequence improved
	Fix: Firewall sound fixes
	Fix: Prevent fire background effect from disappearing suddenly upon death
	Fix: Firewall death now registers as a kill

Sinoid Boss:
	Updated sprites
	Added x movement
	
GFX: Updated GFX on final levels before Firewall
GFX: ASCII effect transitions added to asteroid void levels
GFX: Made crush lightning narrower

Many more miscellaneous improvements

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] New and improved lighting effects for explosions, bullets, etc.
[*] Big Bubble enemies shoot bullets now.
[*] New boss added: 'Sinoid'
[*] Revision of final boss graphics and game play.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42397695/a351c3339d7a07e914e474d70fecf69f07fdbd93.gif[/img]
[*] Player can now shoot backwards by double tapping left and firing.
[*] New player death sequence where skeleton explodes.
[*] Map stats dialogue no longer shows continues in Explore mode.
[*] Maps stats dialogue now shows levels completed.
[*] Wizzy tips are now disabled in Arcade mode.
[*] End of game outro cut scene added.
[*] Improvements to intro cut scene.
[*] Updated leaderboard to show Steam user IDs and update from Steam every time it's shown.
[*] Current user is now highlighted on leaderboard.
[*] Several music tracks revised.
[*] Balancing of music and SFX volumes.
[*] Several levels revised / tweaked to improve game play and graphics.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bug fixed where player can sometimes shoot through blastable blocks.
[*] Bug fixed where HP icons in HUD flash briefly on player death.
[*] Bug fixed where points dropped by blastable blocks on levels with sine movement are incorrectly positioned.
[*] Bug fixed where enemies awkwardly change firing target after player dies.
[*] Bug fixed where game crashed on highscore input
[/list]

**Note** Previous high scores and saved games will be lost when updating to this version.
